name: Ivatsevichy-Kobryn-Dolyna Gas Pipeline, third string
monitor_reason: length: only one source (a Soviet-era design institute table) lists a third string, and its lengths (374.1 and 394.2 km) conflict with the 292 km on the two existing rows, so no sourced length can be staged. Existence of a third string is also uncorroborated.
researcher_notes: A Ukrainian gas design institute page (Russian language, archived June 2022) lists a line called Ivatsevichy-Dolina, strings 2 and 3, 1200 mm, 5.4 MPa, 374.1 and 394.2 km, with the figure 3 in the last column. The page does not say whether 3 counts strings or something else, and it also lists Torzhok-Minsk-Ivatsevichy with 3 in the same column. Two web searches found no second source for a third string. One summary found said the route has 2 strings; another gave 782 km and 1976 start. The two rows already on the sheet (P3484 string I and P5938 string II) cover the same corridor at 292 km each. This could be a length mismatch on those rows, or a real third string, and the page cannot tell which. Most of the pipe is also in Belarus. No sponsor or new step applies since this would be an old operating line. Treat as an Update question on P3484 and P5938 lengths. Not staged as a new row.
